question: To which of the following countries did the Export-Import Bank of India extend a $250 million line of credit for improving power supply quality in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mozambique__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Export-Import Bank of India on** 3rd August 2020 extended a $250 million line of credit to Mozambique for improving power supply quality.**
 
• The agreement was signed by **Saroj Khuntia, general manager, of Exim Bank**, and **Adriano Isaias Ubisse, National Directorate of Treasury, Ministry of Economy and Finance, Mozambique**.
 
• After signing this LOC agreement the EXIM bank of India had a total of **14 LOCs with Mozambique with a total value of $772.44**.
 
• **A line of credit** is a **flexible loan from a financial institution/Government that consists of a defined amount of money that you can access as needed and repay either immediately or overtime**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** EXIM Bank - Export-Imports Bank**
